title: Printing throughput with local optimization
accepted_explanation: Operators are not working fast enough.
observations: Jobs wait in a queue between preparation, press, and finishing.
Local productivity targets reward keeping individual equipment utilized.
Expedited jobs interrupt the planned sequence.
Rework returns jobs to earlier workflow stages.
Backlog grows while departments meet local productivity targets.
participant_claims: Supervisors say staffing is the primary problem.
Operators say priority changes cause setup losses.
researcher_interpretations: The system may optimize local utilization instead of throughput.
assumptions: Individual operator speed is the principal cause of late delivery.
missing_evidence: Touch time versus waiting time by job.
Frequency and source of priority changes.
